spatial_reference: Each stain center and cup return pose is the episode-specific world position initially covered by that cup. Temporary cup targets are independently sampled world positions. The sponge starts and ends in the yellow tool region.
high_level_instruction: Fetch the sponge, clean the stains under both cups one at a time, return each cup to its own original position, then return the sponge to the yellow region.

observe_cups.label: stand in front of both cups and observe their original positions

fetch_sponge.label: navigate to the yellow region and pick up the sponge

stage_sponge.label: return to the cups and put down the sponge

move_primary_cup.label: move the first cup aside to reveal its stain

wipe_primary_stain.label: pick up the sponge and wipe the first stain

place_sponge_primary.label: put down the sponge after the first wipe

pick_primary_cup.label: pick up the displaced first cup

return_primary_cup.label: return the first cup to its original position

move_secondary_cup.label: move the second cup aside to reveal its stain

wipe_secondary_stain.label: pick up the sponge and wipe the second stain

place_sponge_secondary.label: put down the sponge after the second wipe

pick_secondary_cup.label: pick up the displaced second cup

return_secondary_cup.label: return the second cup to its original position

return_sponge.label: pick up the sponge and return it to the yellow tool region
